response.sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), bench AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS b FROM rates WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.arcref, r.fundflux, r.rate, r.rate - b.b AS gap_above_benchmark FROM rates r CROSS JOIN bench b WHERE r.rate > b.b ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC LIMIT 10
